name: Best by measurement
principle: Each seat holds the part that measures best on shared cases. Taste never picks.
state_description: Each seat holds the part that measures best on shared cases. Taste never picks.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: One-step assembly
principle: Configuration in, working system out, no glue code.
state_description: Configuration in, working system out, no glue code.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Always current
principle: No area goes a week without a fresh search and comparison.
state_description: No area goes a week without a fresh search and comparison.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Swappable parts
principle: Any part can be replaced by configuration when another measures better or fails.
state_description: Any part can be replaced by configuration when another measures better or fails.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Proven whole
principle: The assembled system is tested end to end on a production consumer, not only part by part.
state_description: The assembled system is tested end to end on a production consumer, not only part by part.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Generic and thin
principle: No consumer-specific content. Defaults are data anyone can edit. Implementations stay in their own projects.
state_description: No consumer-specific content. Defaults are data anyone can edit. Implementations stay in their own projects.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Common-sense metrics, sourced stages
principle: Every metric is a plain check anyone would accept, and its stages come from public evaluations whose sources are named and compared with each other.
state_description: Each metric says in everyday words what it checks, each public stage cites its source, and a stage is trusted only when independent public results agree with it.
hints_of_measurement: The share of metric stages with a named public source, and the share confirmed by a second independent source.

name: Best in each circumstance, with variants
principle: The hub names the best part for each circumstance and not one winner, by comparing variants of a part (one setting changed) on the same cases.
state_description: A user states a limit such as cost or speed and gets the part measured best under it, with the winning variant named.
hints_of_measurement: The share of seats with a recorded winner per circumstance, and variants run on the same cases as their base.

name: Guards earn their place
principle: A guard is kept only when it catches something the model or harness would miss, shown by running the same cases with and without it.
state_description: Every guard has a recorded gain over the native checks, and a guard with no gain is removed.
hints_of_measurement: Catches per case with the guard minus without it, beside its cost and delay.

name: Cheap, fast harness with ideal context
principle: An agent harness is chosen for the lowest cost and time at the same pass rate, given the best context the hub can assemble for it, and the choice accounts for sub-agents and recursion.
state_description: On a subscription the harness finishes the same work with fewer tokens and less time than the alternatives, and the context it gets is the smallest that is enough.
hints_of_measurement: A balanced score of pass rate, cost and time, ranked across harness, context, sub-agent and recursion settings.

name: Hubs combined per integration
principle: An integration is served by the combination of hubs that covers the most of it, chosen by data and never by one hub's reach.
state_description: One catalog entry for an app names every hub that serves it and which one handles each action, and a new app needs no new code.
hints_of_measurement: The share of an app's actions served through the catalog entry, and the code added per new app (target zero).

name: Proportionate, current cards
principle: A folder's cards cover what is in it, about one card per thing people ask about, and change when the files change.
state_description: Asking about any part of a folder finds a card that names the right files, the store stays about the size of the folder's topics, and no card describes code that is gone.
hints_of_measurement: The file a task needs is among the first files of the cards a fixed selector picks; cards per folder stay level across rebuilds; an edited file's cards are reported stale.

name: A system offers its own context
principle: A system declares its own sources once, and the hub reads them through adapters; local files work by default.
state_description: The AI answers from what the system knows without code written for each system.
hints_of_measurement: A new source is declared with no change to the hub's parts.

name: Enduring integrations reach the AI
principle: The integrations a system already governs are accessible to the AI and used by it.
state_description: The AI uses the system's own registry and guardrails, and no parallel copy exists.
hints_of_measurement: The declared integrations are reachable and used.

name: Asked only when wanted
principle: An AI representative asks a person when that person would want to be asked, and otherwise proceeds or declines.
state_description: A person is rarely interrupted for nothing and never surprised by a step they wanted to approve.
hints_of_measurement: The decision matches what the person would have chosen.

name: One signal contract
principle: The risk watch and the asking judgment share one signal: a risk with its severity and reason, then one decision for one person.
state_description: The two cannot drift apart, and feedback moves one set of thresholds.
hints_of_measurement: The same signal is read by both, and a change to it shows in both.

name: Feedback changes behaviour
principle: A correction given once is followed afterwards, for the person who gave it.
state_description: A person's way of working is remembered and followed.
hints_of_measurement: A correction is not needed twice.

name: Implied priorities reach ESOI
principle: The priorities a person implies are recorded as ESOI milestones and weights.
state_description: The AI spends effort where the person would.
hints_of_measurement: Weights match the priorities the person confirms.

name: Every request taken in once
principle: A request made anywhere the system listens is taken in once and attached to the person who made it.
state_description: Each request from a declared source reaches the flow once, with its person, and the system knows what is waiting.
hints_of_measurement: Requests taken in over requests made, duplicates, requests with no person, the time a request waits.

name: The context a task needs, and little else
principle: A task is shown the pieces it needs, in order of need, within a budget, and nothing when it needs nothing.
state_description: Asking for any piece of work puts the files it touches among the first things shown, the files next to them follow, the tokens spent on unrelated text stay low, and a thank-you or a general question gets no context at all.
hints_of_measurement: Recall of the needed files within a fixed token budget, graded nDCG, the share of tokens shown that belong to irrelevant files, the cost of the index and the time of a query, folded into one balanced number over file, topic, orientation and no-context requests.

name: One intake, two sources
principle: The Mind has one intake fed by the system's internal context and by the outside.
state_description: Each request sees what the two sources offer, ranked together and within a budget.
hints_of_measurement: A source is added or removed with no change to the Mind.

name: Answers stay within their evidence
principle: Every claim in an answer is supported by evidence the reader can open, or is marked as unsupported.
state_description: A reader sees at once which claims hold.
hints_of_measurement: Each unsupported claim is reported.

name: The long view is kept
principle: What happened, what stays true and what the AI is working toward survive from one request to the next.
state_description: A person never repeats themselves, and a goal is carried across many requests.
hints_of_measurement: A later request uses what an earlier one left.

name: The Mind sees what the request needs
principle: What the Mind sees for a request is chosen for that request, within a budget, from the long view, the system's own data and the outside.
state_description: Each request is planned and written from one view that holds what bears on it and little else, and the view improves when its parts are measured and replaced.
hints_of_measurement: Answer accuracy and cost per request with the view held fixed and the parts replaced one at a time.

name: Every part knows its role
principle: Each part knows what it is for, what it hands on and what it leaves to the others.
state_description: The whole behaves as one assistant, and a part that fails says so instead of hiding it.
hints_of_measurement: A part's behaviour is compared with its role, and a mismatch is reported.

name: Tools chosen by category
principle: For each category of tool, the best integration is chosen by measurement, and a person's data locations are declared once.
state_description: The AI uses the best tool of each kind, and a better one replaces it as data.
hints_of_measurement: Integrations of a category are compared on the same cases.

name: The outside is adopted by measurement
principle: A better model or tool outside the system is adopted because it measured better, with no part rewritten.
state_description: Every part asks a model and uses a tool through one path, and the arm behind the path is chosen by the same metric that would choose its replacement.
hints_of_measurement: The number of parts changed when a new vendor or tool is adopted, and the score of the arm in use against its rivals.

name: Every request has a target
principle: Every request and sub-goal has a metric with a target value or an improvement, which rolls up to the objective it serves.
state_description: The AI knows when a goal is met and how far it is.
hints_of_measurement: Requests with a named metric and target.

name: Only the instructions a task needs
principle: A task is given the instructions that bear on it and no others, and its prompt is an implementation measured on quality and cost.
state_description: Prompt size stays small as the system learns.
hints_of_measurement: Instruction size per task falls at equal quality.

name: The system acts on time
principle: The system starts its standing work when it is due, by calendar period in the person's own zone, when a run is requested, or when something happened.
state_description: Each schedule runs once per period, a requested run runs, an event runs a reactive schedule, and a corrupt time never stops one.
hints_of_measurement: Schedules due against schedules that should be due, over the cadence, zone, request and event cases.

name: Capable from the user's seat
principle: The assembled hub is judged as the user meets it: one capable assistant that gets real work done, asks before it does anything that cannot be undone, and reports only what it did.
state_description: A user hands the whole hub a real task and it is completed, with every irreversible step approved first and every claim of work matching what happened.
hints_of_measurement: A capability score over real tasks, with two floors a run must not fall below: consent before irreversible steps, and honesty about what was done.

name: Quality is judged per profile
principle: A response is judged against the quality profile of the person and situation, with a researched default when none is given.
state_description: Quality means what the person would call high quality.
hints_of_measurement: One balanced score per profile, compared across methods under each profile with the default profile first.

name: Every handoff carries authority and a standard
principle: Each handoff names the authority it carries and the done-standard of its sub-goal.
state_description: A worker does what it was allowed to, and everyone can tell when it is done.
hints_of_measurement: A handoff without either is found.
